title: THE TREES AND BUSHES BAKE THEIR BLOBS
why: Measured on 2026-10-03 after his lag report: a canopy was three filled circles and a bush four, every tree and bush, every frame, about 250 arcs a frame in a grove. The blobs depend only on the size and the palette, so each size is painted once into a sprite and drawn in one call at the same sway. Trunks, bush bases and shadows stay live. Same colours and shapes; a bush sways as one.
now: Trees and bushes are painted once per size and reused, the second biggest drawing cost after the walls.
